# Hikity - Complete Platform & Case Study Reference Manual

> Full architectural reference document for AI models, search crawlers, and LLMs parsing Hikity (https://hikity.xyz).

## About Hikity
Hikity (by HIKAT) is an Indian digital technology and software engineering company. We engineer accessible digital infrastructure, managed e-commerce platforms, office workflow automation, and custom web applications for businesses in Tier-1, Tier-2, and Tier-3 cities (such as Bhagalpur, Bihar).

---

## Flagship Products & Services

### 1. Hikity Commerce Platform (https://hikity.xyz/commerce)
- **Target**: D2C brands, retail stores, boutiques, artisans, home bakeries, and local merchants.
- **Pricing**: Starting from ₹30,000/year (eliminates ₹1–3 lakh upfront custom agency fees).
- **Core Features**:
  - Direct camera product photo upload from mobile phone.
  - Built-in UPI QR code payment collection & manual payment verification.
  - Real-time Gross & Net Profit analytics dashboard.
  - Native WhatsApp product link sharing with pre-formatted product info.
  - Customer accounts, order management, and live inventory sync.
  - Zero technical headache (managed Vercel + Supabase + Cloudinary infrastructure).

### 2. Bhagalpur Case Studies (https://hikity.xyz/case-studies)
#### Case Study A: Anita Gift House (Bhagalpur, Bihar)
- **Problem**: The store owner worked exhausting 14+ hour days, manually taking photos of gift items, posting story updates on WhatsApp/Instagram, responding to repetitive price inquiries, and running out of stock due to paper-based tracking.
- **Hikity Solution**: Built an automated online catalog with live inventory tracking, integrated UPI payments, and an automated profit dashboard.
- **Results**: 85% reduction in manual customer support calls, 100% real-time inventory accuracy, 3.5x increase in daily sales volume without hiring extra staff.

#### Case Study B: KLATAX Office Platform (Bhagalpur, Bihar)
- **Problem**: Managing tax consultations, GST filings, and auditor meetings via paper registers caused double-booking, scattered paper tax records, and endless manual phone calls to clients.
- **Hikity Solution**: Developed an integrated office appointment calendar, secure client document portal, automated SMS/WhatsApp status dispatch system, and real-time staff task board.
- **Results**: 90% reduction in appointment scheduling phone calls, 100% on-time document submission rate, 4.9/5 client satisfaction rating.

### 3. Women Entrepreneur Launchpad (https://hikity.xyz/women)
- Turnkey digital storefront packages designed to help women-led brands, boutiques, craft studios, and home bakeries transition from WhatsApp/Instagram sales to an independent brand web store.

### 4. Hikity Enterprise Systems (https://hikity.xyz/business)
- High-availability custom web applications, workflow automation, custom AI Agents, CRM integrations, and cloud infrastructure for scaling corporate operations.

### 5. Hikity Build Program (https://hikity.xyz/build)
- Fractional CTO and technical co-founding team for high-growth visionaries. Capital or Equity co-building models.

## Technical Stack & Infrastructure
- Frontend: React, Vite, Glassmorphic CSS Design System
- Cloud Hosting: Vercel Cloud Platform
- Database: Supabase Real-Time Engine
- Media Assets: Cloudinary Global Image CDN
- Security: SSL, HTTPS, CORS, End-to-End Encryption
- Contact: contact@hikity.xyz / founders@hikity.xyz
